adversarial_audit.objection: Affine structure must live in reducing carrier cores.
adversarial_audit.resolution: It instead appears in the canonical coefficient effects, which remain affine when the carrier intersection is emergent.

adversarial_audit.objection: Any balanced merge has a coefficient-affine certificate.
adversarial_audit.resolution: A repeated-label balanced node has a uniform six-mask support, which is nonaffine; nine other repeated-label nodes are unbalanced.

adversarial_audit.objection: The partial coefficient transfer is already efficient.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Its present formula contains pseudoinverses of child frames and is a structural target, not a compiled operation.

adversarial_audit.objection: Collision-free labels prevent all recoupling collisions.
adversarial_audit.resolution: The companion S6 control has eight globally distinct source partitions and still exhibits matrix partial-support traffic.

claim_gate.reason: The finite scalar coefficient-space controls are exact, but a natural S6 node falsifies their universal extension. A matrix partial-support compiler and mass theorem are required.

falsifiers_triggered: Affine carrier-core exhaustion is the wrong necessary condition; canonical coefficient affinity survives emergent intersections.
Balanced shorted metrics do not force affine coefficient support.
External label distinctness does not by itself prove internal multiplicity-free recoupling; S6 already supplies a counterexample.

proof_obligations.resolution: Moore-Penrose identities prove both equations and every finite node validates them numerically.
All label-simple finite overlaps have affine uniform scalar effects in coefficient space despite nonreducing carriers.
Rejected by the companion globally source-distinct S6 control: affine masks coexist with nonscalar component effects and noncommuting cross-child supports.
The current certificate defines D_(A,e) using A^+; no multiplicity-basis or Racah circuit constructs it directly.

summary: Moved the affine mechanism into minimum-norm coefficient space, where W3/W5 have scalar certificates but a globally distinct S6 affine node forces matrix-valued partial supports.

theorem_contract.coefficient_affine_normal_form: Finite label-simple controls have scalar equal component weights supported on an affine mask set.
theorem_contract.coefficient_transfer: For isometric child decompositions, D_B D_A^* is a partial isometry between their coefficient images.
theorem_contract.isometric_balance: If G_A=G_B=gI, the two stacked coefficient maps become isometries after common normalization and every fractional relative channel is 1/2.
theorem_contract.minimum_norm_synthesis: D_(A,e)=E_e A^+U sums to U and its component Gram operators sum to G_A=U^*A^+U.
theorem_contract.scope: The canonical maps use child pseudoinverses. The companion sparse-Gram S6 control falsifies scalar component effects even with globally distinct sources and affine masks, so the all-n target must be matrix-valued partial support.
